settings.kicker: Be part of a global team
settings.heading: Join a Team That Values What You Bring
settings.text: We look for people who care about doing meaningful work well, who bring their own perspective, and who are willing to listen to someone else’s. You will work with colleagues and specialists across countries, cultures, disciplines, and time zones. We value people who take ownership, stay curious, speak up respectfully, and care whether what we do makes a positive difference. Bring your judgment, your experience, and the questions you think we should be asking.

settings.question: Who is VECTRA International?
settings.answer: VECTRA International is a business resilience and operational capability-building partner. We help organizations manage responsible business, supplier, and operational challenges by combining experienced people, practical implementation support, and technology where it adds value.

settings.question: When was VECTRA International founded?
settings.answer: VECTRA International was founded in 2005. Since then, our work has grown from responsible business and supply-chain challenges into a broader role supporting business resilience, operational capability, governance, and performance.

settings.question: What does VECTRA International do?
settings.answer: We help organizations turn complex requirements and operational challenges into clear priorities and practical action. Depending on the issue, that may involve supplier risk, governance, evidence, technology, capability building, responsible business, or operational improvement.

settings.question: How is VECTRA different from a traditional consulting company?
settings.answer: VECTRA consulting support is built around partnership, implementation, and follow-through. Organizations may come to us while looking for an operational resilience consulting company, but our role is broader. We bring together specialist expertise, capability building, practical implementation, and technology where it adds value, then stay involved as decisions move into practice and progress is measured.

settings.question: Where does VECTRA International operate?
settings.answer: VECTRA International works globally, supported by associates and specialist experts who bring local context and experience across regions, markets, and industries.

settings.question: Who leads VECTRA International?
settings.answer: VECTRA International is led by CEO Patrick Neyts alongside a global leadership team spanning operations, sales and marketing, and applied AI.
